notes: Repair full application from immutable HEAD 56c073175f12f38b6c861b382a8f197df71b416c. Clean source checkout; no dirty work included. Origin https://github.com/snowopsdev/datum.git. No matching campaign found in all 3 registered worktrees including hidden state search. Three workers and coordinator, capacity-aware lane waves. Authorized commits/push/draft PRs/deferred issues/review responses, never merge. Local Postgres snow role available; Docker unavailable. Mock providers only; each lane isolated database; env hook copies ignored local credentials so lane configuration must override DATABASE_URL/MOCK_MODE and webhook settings before any app process. Target 100 unique reproduced roots, not a quota. Primary: finite scenario inventory per lane; expansion at most 3 passes with 9 scenarios each, stopping after 2 fully covered zero-new passes. Stress each <=300s, <=500 operations including retries, <=20 concurrency ramping from 1; local only, stop on sustained errors/integrity risk/throttling. Startup 180s plus one evidenced retry. CI max 2 attempts per same failure, observe up to 10 minutes. No platform goal exists or requested.
